title: Time clear or expiry bypasses per-step correction bounds
description: Correctness review: ordinary StratumTracker.clear/expiry discards the current reference, and _adopt applies max_forward_step/max_backward_step only while a current sample exists. A replacement correction can therefore exceed the per-step bound while remaining under the cumulative anchor budget, contrary to spec 09. Retain a projected correction reference across non-admin invalidation and enforce per-step before cumulative bounds; only bound-admin recovery may reset it. Add clear and expiry regressions.
